verdict.rationale: Slate is a terminal-based coding agent, so kicking off tasks from GitHub, GitLab, Linear or Slack is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents starting and orchestrating tasks from within the TUI (sessions, queueing, subagents). None of it shows integrations that trigger agent tasks from those external platforms.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack
